title: place-names-floods: analysis code, frozen protocol and amendments for a test of whether machine-read settlement names improve gridded predictions of mapped river flooding
description: Analysis code, frozen protocol (docs/protocol/preregistration_v2.md; the protocol was time-stamped in the development repository but not registered with a third party, and the file name is kept because the checksums verify it) with English translations of the protocol and its amendments, the frozen multilingual lexicon, coded etymology excerpts, the figure and table generator and Online Resource 2 for the study 'Testing machine-read settlement names as predictors of mapped river flooding: limitations of a gridded evaluation' (R. Okauchi and P.-J. Chun, manuscript for Natural Hazards). PROVENANCE.md gives the freeze record and the checksums that verify the frozen files. The derived data (cell tables, language-model name readings, held-out predictions and run summaries) are archived in a separate Zenodo record.
